answer: Rooftop solar verified from orbit is hard to fake at scale. The applicant shows satellite imagery of panels on their roof plus a grid feed-in meter record in their name. Installing panels costs thousands and leaves a visible, dated record, so a farm would need a thousand real roofs to field a thousand copies, while one honest agent just shares the meter reading they already have. The anchor is the roof itself, the falcon view from the satellite confirms it, and the garden of panels keeps generating proof every sunny day.
